550892b1: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and the DUZ user has an entry in ^DISV for the current DLB, set X to that value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write out X preceded by '  '.

6b51868a: ;Execute code from the INPUT transform for the current field (if it exists), and check DIC('S') if present. If transform or DIC('S') sets X to null, go to V. If DB(DQ) is undefined, write out the transformed value preceded by '  '. Otherwise, go to V.

e092fc5c: ;Loop through each ';' piece of DU. DG is set to the piece position of X within the current piece of DU. If DG is non-zero, execute DIC('S') if present, and quit the loop if DIC('S') returns true.
457f7266: ;If DB(DQ) is undefined, write out the substring of the current piece of DU starting at position DG. Set X to the piece of DU before the first ':'.

90d08522: ;If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the value of DU prefixed by U_. Set DIC(0) based on whether DB(DQ) is defined ('EN' if defined, 'EM' if not) and whether DV contains ''' ('L' if it does, nothing if not). If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV delimited by 'P'. If DV doesn't contain '*', execute ^DIC. Set X to the value of Y, and set DIC back to DIE. Go to X if X is negative.
ca6be2a6: ;If DV doesn't contain 'N', execute D. If the length of the piece of X after the decimal point is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.

e059ea1e: ;If the second piece of DV delimited by ',' is non-zero, X contains '.', and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) delimited by U doesn't contain '$', perform some string manipulation on X to remove leading/trailing zeros and truncate the decimal portion if necessary. If the decimal portion is blank and X contains '.', set X to its integer portion.
